producer_prior: Exact native statements have producer checks; independent source fidelity not established.
mutual_blindness: Separate reviewer sessions; withhold other reviewers findings until independent reports are sealed.

joints.claim: canonical choose/transform/map_divisor and related collector bodies
joints.worked_attack: Try the known wrong first-61-line gate excerpt; demand exact named ranges and explicit identifier changes.
joints.blind_rederivation: Independently extract each named body and reconstruct call order.

joints.claim: small powers, binomial recurrence, wide modular product and inversion
joints.worked_attack: Use p=0,1, composite p, noncanonical residues, a=0, k>5 and maximal words; identify excluded domains before applying lemmas.
joints.blind_rederivation: Derive each intermediate bound and inverse premise directly from Rust operations.

joints.claim: nested immutable coefficient / mutable slot traversal, trim and pad
joints.worked_attack: Drop a row, change iteration order, alias coefficient with output, insert an internal zero, exceed capacity.
joints.blind_rederivation: Derive the coefficient sum and prove exact slice lengths from source degree constraints.

joints.claim: degree metadata, monicity, canonical inputs and ignored array tails
joints.worked_attack: Supply degree metadata inconsistent with natDegree, degree>2, or nonzero unused tails; check what is assumed and what source actually validates.
joints.blind_rederivation: Trace constructors/callers that establish each premise; do not infer validity from array length.

joints.claim: source returns original divisor unchanged; model proves decoded identity validity
joints.worked_attack: Keep arbitrary unused storage words with degree0; distinguish byte identity from decoded polynomial identity.
joints.blind_rederivation: Derive u=1,v=0 from the precise validity predicate and degree premise.

joints.claim: monic u, degree bound, ordinate bound and divisibility
joints.worked_attack: Use singular f, a=0 and nonmonic u; determine whether any geometric claim was smuggled into polynomial validity.
joints.blind_rederivation: Derive scaling powers d,3,6 and transport each of the four clauses.

joints.claim: polynomial round trips and affine signed-support equivalence
joints.worked_attack: Reverse direction, negate beta incorrectly, omit y scaling, or discard sign; verify which controls detect each mutation.
joints.blind_rederivation: Derive inverse coordinate map from x_old=a*x_new+b and y_old=a^3*y_new.

joints.claim: all-power divisibility and exact finite polynomial multiplicity
joints.worked_attack: Use zero polynomial, k=0, repeated root, ramified curve point; reject any inference equating polynomial and curve valuation without a bridge.
joints.blind_rederivation: Derive quotient transport and both directions using the inverse; state valuation obligations separately.

joints.claim: native checks, axiom audit, compiled cache trust boundary
joints.worked_attack: Alter imported helper after receipt; omit a module; use prebuilt olean with mismatched source.
joints.blind_rederivation: Rebuild exact named modules in an isolated immutable tree and perform fresh axiom readback.

joints.claim: remaining local valuations, infinity and principal-divisor transport
joints.worked_attack: Attempt to claim a Jacobian group isomorphism from rational-point tests or polynomial validity alone.
joints.blind_rederivation: Construct the curve/function-field map, extend it at infinity and derive local orders before group transport.

required_outputs: fresh native receipts and axiom audit
counterexample or explicit domain for each attack
